releaseTitle: Hotspot Manager v1.6.2 - Active-Vouchers-Only Query Architecture
releaseNotes:
• Targeted Active-Voucher-Only Architecture: The app now queries user properties ONLY for actively connected hotspot sessions (?name=...) instead of dumping all 5,000+ voucher records from the router. This completely resolves CPU spikes on low/mid-range routers like KyawGyi.
• 100% Exact Quota & Time Enforcement: Real-time bytes-in/out and session-time-left counters from active sessions ensure byte-exact data quota cutting and second-exact session duration cutting.
• Smart Active User Cache: Automatically caches active user profiles while online and clears them on disconnect, avoiding redundant API calls.
• Reduced Network Payload: Polling payload reduced from ~2 MB to under 4 KB per cycle, dramatically improving responsiveness over remote relay/WireGuard tunnels.
• Throttled Background Services: Network topology and IP binding sync throttled to prevent background burst load.
